constraints: Only keywords set via IPTC/Keywords metadata are considered; other metadata types are ignored, and only picture formats that support this metadata (JPEG, TIFF, etc.) are supported.
If the picture has no keywords/IPTC metadata, an empty array is returned and no error is raised.

overloadMerges.note: Corrected direction: arrKeywords is filled in by the command ('←' in the docs), not passed in.

params.description: If passed, only distinct (de-duplicated) keyword values are returned.
